data.description:
## Technical Environment
- Plugin: dso v1.17.0
- File: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh
- code_version: 52991360fd254bf31333169263863c7e6d5fcb4d

## Incident Overview
- Scenario Type: Discovered during fix-bug for f6fd-af80-9b13-4649

### Expected Behavior
When dso-config.conf has `dso.workflow=ci-pr` (canonical key per CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md), the enforcement-gate.sh library should treat the effective strategy as "ci" and short-circuit hooks that defer to CI (review-gate, test-gate, test-quality-gate). This mirrors the change applied to mode-detect.sh (commit fb2cc273a6) and the dso.workflow shim added to read-config.sh (commit 93bb004e58).

### Actual Behavior
enforcement-gate.sh reads enforcement.strategy directly via `grep -m1 '^enforcement\\.strategy='` and defaults to "local" when absent. It does not check dso.workflow. So projects configured with only `dso.workflow=ci-pr` (no deprecated legacy keys) get local hooks firing despite the canonical config indicating ci-pr workflow.

### Action History
Observed during /dso:fix-bug f6fd commit phase. The repo has `dso.workflow=ci-pr` set, `enforcement.strategy=` absent. The pre-commit review-gate hook will fire locally because enforcement-gate.sh sees absent → defaults to local.

## Skills and Workflows
- Affected hooks: pre-commit-review-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh (any hook sourcing enforcement-gate.sh)
- Affected workflows: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3 (also reads enforcement.strategy directly via grep)

## Additional Details
Same fix pattern used in read-config.sh dso.workflow shim: read dso.workflow first; legacy fallback with deprecation warning; missing both → loud warning. Or simpler: delegate to read-config.sh which has the shim already.

Fix scope: enforcement-gate.sh _dso_enforcement_gate_check() should check dso.workflow first. May also want to audit COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3.

Related to f6fd-af80-9b13-4649.
data.title: enforcement-gate.sh: reads enforcement.strategy via grep -> does not honor dso.workflow=ci-pr -> review-gate fires locally when project is ci-pr mode
